content:
Kara: New engineering manager joins Mon. Need a very short manager+HR checklist, a one-paragraph welcome blurb for the offer, and a tiny 30/60/90 bullets list. Also: who handles badge & KMS? :wave:

Dmitri: Quick checklist: preboard (laptop & Okta), Day1 People Ops (payroll/benefits), Day1 manager welcome (30m), Day1 afternoon access sweep (GitHub, VPN), Day2 buddy pair & run CI smoke test, End week 30m readout.

Ivy: Who to ping: badge/parking -> @Facilities; KMS/VPN -> #security-ops (I can fast-track with manager approval).

Kara: One-paragraph welcome blurb please  candidate-facing.

Dmitri: Paste: "Welcome week (short): Day 1 includes People Ops onboarding and a manager welcome, followed by an IT/access check and a relaxed team lunch. Day 2 youll pair with your assigned buddy to set up your dev environment and run the onboarding smoke test. Day 3 includes a short security & infra orientation. Day 4 is time for a small hands-on task (first PR). Day 5 is a 30-minute wrap with your manager to align on 30-day priorities."

Ivy: 30/60/90 bullets: 30d stable access + first small change merged; 60d leading a small deliverable and improving a runbook; 90d delivering an initiative and mentoring new hires.

Facilities: Badge note: need local phone and onsite days to prep QR pass.

HR Bot: Onboard packet created: "Eng Manager - start 2026-04-13". Tasks assigned: Kara (manager), Dmitri (people-ops), Ivy (security), Facilities. Link: https://hr.redwood.internal/onboard/ENG-5543

Kara: Thanks all, this is perfect. Ill paste into the offer and DM phone/onsite days to Facilities.
